retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic 2000s-era hip-hop aesthetic featuring a central figure on rocky terrain against a fiery sunset with heavy, beveled chrome typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure stands atop dark, jagged rocks, silhouetted against a vibrant orange and red sunset sky. Large, 3D chrome-textured letters dominate the upper half of the frame, featuring heavy beveling and metallic reflections.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned centrally between large-scale typographic elements
High contrast between dark foreground rocks and bright sunset background
Metallic texture of text reflecting the warm tones of the sky
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the height of the subject and the scale of the letters
coreInvariants: Heavy 3D chrome beveling on all display text
Fiery orange-to-red gradient sky with high-contrast clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central full-body figure, scaled to occupy the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large chrome display text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large metallic text, move down to the central figure, and settle on the dark rocky base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with clouds, text, and terrain.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky with high value contrast in the metallic reflections.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D extrusion with a sharp 45-degree bevel
Brushed metal or chrome surface texture
Inner glow and outer drop shadow for depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dots or periods replaced with faceted diamond-like graphic elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales and weights for primary and secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for heavy beveling.
Offers a wide, masculine geometric feel suitable for the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dramatic sunset over a jagged, dark rocky landscape with a central figure standing on the rocks, leaving the top half of the sky clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, 3D beveled chrome text in a heavy sans-serif font across the top, adding lens flares to the metallic edges.

verificationChecks: Is the text 3D with a chrome texture?
Is the sky a vibrant orange/red sunset?
Is the foreground composed of dark, jagged rocks?

postGenerationChecks: Check that chrome text has visible beveling and depth.
Ensure the sunset colors are saturated and not washed out.
Verify the subject is integrated naturally into the rocky environment.
Confirm the diamond accents are present in the punctuation.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Dramatic Sunset Landscape] + [Central Silhouetted Figure] + [Heavy 3D Chrome Typography] to recreate the 2000s hip-hop aesthetic.
